update_interval.label: Update interval (ms)
update_interval.description: How often history is sampled and the open process list refreshes.

history_length.label: History length (samples)
history_length.description: Number of points kept for every graph.

max_rows.label: Process rows
max_rows.description: Maximum number of processes listed after sorting and filtering.

cpu_scale.label: Per-process CPU scale
cpu_scale.description: Whole machine: all rows add up to total CPU usage. Per core: 100% equals one fully busy core, like top.

show_kernel_threads.label: Show kernel threads
show_kernel_threads.description: Include kworker, ksoftirqd and other kernel threads in the process list.

proc.search: Search by name, user, PID or command…
proc.error_empty: The process sampler returned nothing. Is gawk installed?
proc.hint: Click a row for details and actions
proc.locked: Row order frozen while a process is selected
proc.stale: Left the top of the list

perf.cores_pending: Waiting for the first per-core sample…

sys.gpu_asleep_note: Powered down. Polling pauses until something else wakes it.
sys.gpu_monitor_tip: Poll this card for load, VRAM and temperature. Polling a discrete card keeps it awake; a sleeping card is never woken.
sys.gpu_off_note: Not monitored: the plugin does not touch this card.
